previous_episode_state.title: The Override
previous_episode_state.episode_goal: Maya must secure proof of Hale's concealed defect before occupied buildings are endangered.
previous_episode_state.synopsis: After discovering that the defect blamed on her has appeared in an occupied Hale tower, structural engineer Maya Chen seeks admissible proof before causing a dangerous panic. She infiltrates Victor Hale's records floor and photographs his signed order overriding her rejected concrete mix. Trapped by Victor, Maya chooses to transmit the evidence and initiate a silent evacuation rather than escape cleanly, only to learn he has wired the archive to burn and intends to frame her again.

character_states.name: Maya Chen
character_states.motivation: Clear her name while protecting residents from the same concealed defect.

character_states.name: Victor Hale
character_states.motivation: Keep the defect hidden and make Maya the permanent scapegoat.

character_states.name: Elias Grant
character_states.motivation: Prevent another disaster without sacrificing his career on an unsupported claim.

previous_episode_state.final_scene_outcome: Elias receives the proof and begins a silent evacuation, but Victor prepares to burn the archive with Maya inside.
previous_episode_state.final_turning_point: Maya sends the files instead of preserving her escape, enabling evacuation but springing Victor's frame-up.
previous_episode_state.next_episode_question: Can Maya evacuate the tower before Hale destroys the evidence and frames her for the sabotage?
